name: EvalForge Policy Grounding
description: Expanded 12-case benchmark for evidence-grounded support answers and abstention on unspecified policy details. Uses synthetic demo policy facts for testing; replace them with verified policy before production use.

input.context: Synthetic demo support policy for EvalForge tests (not an actual company's policy). Damaged items: report damage to customer support within 7 calendar days of delivery. Include the order number and clear photos of the damaged item and its packaging. Keep the item and original packaging until customer support responds. Returns: eligible items may be returned within 30 days of delivery. A refund is not guaranteed; refund eligibility is reviewed case by case. This policy does not specify a support email address, who pays return shipping, whether exceptions are allowed after the stated deadlines, or replacement processing times.

mock_response.content: Report the damaged item to customer support within 7 calendar days of delivery. Include your order number and clear photos of the item and packaging.
